channel.title: SRG+ Key
channel.description: Updates of SRG+ Key for Mac, downloaded outside the App Store.

item.description: - **Key opens the vault you used last.** After a restart or an unlock it no longer jumps to My Vault: it goes back to the vault you picked, for example your work vault.

- **Ask now (new, off by default):** an AI agent can ask for one login. You confirm with Touch ID in Key's own window, and the agent gets that one login for one task. Turn it on in Settings › Agents. - Safer by design: the page is emptied when you leave it, and the agent never sees your vault. - Search in the vault (0.2.3.16) is included.

- **Search at the top.** A wide search field in the middle of the window, as in 1Password. Type and the matching items of all your vaults show right under it, each with its vault; ↑ ↓ pick, Return opens the item (its vault opens with it), Esc closes the list. ⌘F goes to the field. - **Every word counts.** «auto top» finds «Revolut - Auto Top Up»; upper and lower case and accents do not matter. - **You on top of Settings.** Your SRG+ name and photo head Settings, as in every SRG+ app; it opens your Account.

- **Groups.** A workspace's owner can make groups (Sales, Production, Leadership), give a group its vaults once at View or Edit, and put people in it: they get every vault of the group. Taking someone out takes those vaults back with a new key. - **Clear People.** A vault's People shows who has it through which group, and anything that did not go through yet, with Give Again or Take Away. - Update SRG+ Key on all your devices before your first group.

- **Several vaults in a workspace.** A workspace's owner can make more vaults (Sales, Finance, one per client) and give each person only the vaults they need. - **View or Edit.** Each person gets a vault at View (they can only look) or Edit (they can change it). The owner changes the level or takes a vault back from the vault's People. - **Safer by default.** Nothing is shared on its own: only the owner gives a vault. A vault that gets a new key no longer opens for agents until they are given access again, and the app names what they had.
- **Agents sign in to AT&T.** A login for att.com given to an agent now covers AT&T's own sign-in pages (signin.att.com and oidc.idp.clogin.att.com). Give the login to the agent again once to use it.

- **Update at the top.** When a new version is ready, a blue Update button shows at the top right of the window. One click installs it and reopens the app; without a click it still installs when you quit.

- **Give an agent access right from a password.** In a workspace you own, open an item: under «Who can use it», Give Access… lists the agents that do not have it yet. Pick one or more and confirm once with Touch ID. - An agent that already has items in this vault keeps its rule; a new one takes the rule and the time you pick there. - Take Back on an agent's row (right-click) takes that one item back.

- **Your devices follow you into your workspaces.** A workspace made on one of your devices now opens on your others too, by itself: no invite code. Keep SRG+ Key open and unlocked on a device that has the workspace; your iPhone, iPad or Mac shows it within a minute. - While a device waits, the vault switcher says which of your devices can add it.

- **For agents** on logins and API keys: instructions an agent reads before it uses the item (how the site signs in, where a code comes from), separate from your private Notes. - **Sign in with** on logins: Any, Cloud browser or My Chrome. An agent signs in only where you said. - Text that holds the item's password, key or code is not saved: agents read it.

- On an agent's page, Asks Me First, Allowed and Take Back now really change the agent's access, confirmed with Touch ID. Before, they changed only what this Mac showed. - Giving an agent another item keeps its current rule, so items it may use by itself stay allowed.

- An item's «Who can use it» now lists the agents that can use it, with their pictures and whether each use asks you first. - On an agent's page, pick an item to see its details (user name, password, website); double-click it to open it among your items. - What each agent was given now shows after the app starts again.

**Move and copy items between your vaults.**
- **Move to** and **Copy to** take a login, card, bank details, API key or note from My Vault to a workspace vault you can write to, or back. Every field goes with it: the password, the two-step code, the passkey and the notes. - Right-click one item or several in the list, or use the Vault row in the item's details. - A move asks first, and the item leaves its vault only once its copy is on the server. An agent given the item loses it and must be given it again in the new vault.

- Give access now lists the items of the workspace you have open, so the login you pick is the one the agent gets. - Agents show only in a workspace you own. My Vault no longer offers them. - Each SRG+ agent shows its picture from SRG+, and Access › Agents is a page of all agents with search. - Logins and API keys show their website's icon, taken from that website only. Settings › Vault › Show website icons turns it off. - On the Mac, Settings no longer covers the last row of the sidebar.
- Agents: the list now shows the studio's SRG+ agents, so you can give one of them a login or an API key with Touch ID.

- Give an agent of SRG+ access to a login or an API key: pick the agent and the items, confirm with Touch ID. The agent signs in or calls the API through SRG+ Key and never sees the password or the key. - Agents' requests to use an item now show in the app for your yes or no.

- **Updates install by themselves.** The app checks every hour and installs a new version when you quit it. Opened from the disk image or Downloads, it first offers to move itself into Applications, where updates can reach it.

**SRG+ Key for Mac, Beta.** The first version you can download outside the App Store.
- Your passwords, two-step codes, passkeys, cards, bank details, API keys and notes, locked on your Mac with your master password and Secret Key. Unlock with Touch ID. - Fill passwords and codes in Safari and other apps: turn on SRG+ Key in System Settings › General › AutoFill & Passwords. - Bring your passwords over from Apple Passwords, 1Password or a CSV file. - Sign in with your SRG+ account, and add your iPhone with a setup code. - The app checks for updates every hour and installs a new version when you say so.
This is a Beta: keep your Emergency Kit safe, and keep your important passwords in your current password app too for now.
